description: The arm link's core chosen by process: a plain hollow skin, FDM-printable box sections with a rib (uniform walls, or walls and flanges graded along the link), and a skin over a gyroid, each tuned for the lightest link that keeps the arm-link study's safety factor and 0.5 mm deflection, then read for each process. Run: loadpath cores examples/fields/arm-link-cores.json --out cores-out
